title: Harry Potter season fondue (white Meltie mug, sunroom) — restage 09
notes: Restage 09 of shorts/uMl76XX7epo: WHITE variant of the real Meltie Mini Fondue Mug (store photos), the treats on the round marble-top side table (a round marble-top side table in a sunroom at night, dark glass walls with the night outside, big potted palms and ferns, a wicker armchair, warm string lights) instead of the white desk in front of red curtains. Table decor kept (pumpkins, gnome pumpkin, candle jar, laptop). Reworded hook. The pour and the last dip spill on purpose (brief).
